description: This file defines the QueueService class, an Angular service responsible for managing queue-related API interactions, including fetching, saving, deleting queues, and retrieving queue statistics.

classes.name: QueueService
classes.description: An Angular injectable service for managing queues and their statistics via HTTP API calls.

methods.name: getQueueById
methods.description: Fetches queue information by its ID.

methods.name: getQueueByName
methods.description: Fetches queue information by its name.

methods.name: getTenantQueuesByServiceType
methods.description: Retrieves queues filtered by service type with pagination.

methods.name: saveQueue
methods.description: Saves or updates a queue with specified service type.

methods.name: deleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes a queue by its ID.

methods.name: getQueueStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves paginated queue statistics and assigns descriptive names.

methods.name: getQueueStatisticsById
methods.description: Fetches queue statistics by their ID and assigns descriptive name.

methods.name: getQueueStatisticsByIds
methods.description: Fetches multiple queue statistics by their IDs and assigns descriptive names.
